# Candidate-View Dependence {#candidate-view-dependence}

Candidate views can be treated as a finite set rather than unrelated rows;
set-modeling literature provides useful background [@DeepSets-zaheer2017;
@SetTransformer-lee2019; @GeometricDeepLearning-bronstein2021]. This page
does not own the ARIA-NBV equations, model contract, or implementation policy.

The current thesis treatment and evidence boundary are in
[Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ). Executable model interfaces and
duplicate-row/valid-count checks are owned by Python docstrings and tests.
Use [candidate sampling](candidate_sampling_target_selection.qmd) and
[SCONE/FisherRF literature](../literature/scone_fisherrf.qmd) for navigation.
